name: Relia, Inc.
summary: Relia, Inc. provides customer relationship management and business process outsourcing services in Japan. It offers consulting and data analysis, contact center, and digital marketing services; and back office services, such as documents sorting, error checks, data entry, shipping, and delivery of materials to customers, as well as operates face-to-face communication channels with field operations and store-fronts/in-store customer services. The company was formerly known as Moshi Moshi Hotline, Inc. and changed its name to Relia, Inc. in October 2015. Relia, Inc. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
